ui.title: Magnetic · For creativity to impact the world

text.couverture.1: for creativity to impact the world
text.croisement.1:
Magnetic was born where two things met:
what was already there and what came along.
text.deja-la.2:
was Downtown Studio. A place whose values
(the individual at the heart of the collective) already
carried, without knowing it, what Magnetic would build on.
text.arrive.2:
was Together, the immersive experience of the Portail
des Nations. In making it, our creativity served
to convey a strong idea, and in doing so
to impact the world for the better.
text.evidence.1: From this encounter came something obvious:
text.evidence.2:
If creativity could convey
an idea to the world, could it not
become a method for acting upon it?
text.pour-que.1:
Magnetic
For creativity to impact the world
text.geneve.1:
For centuries, Geneva, a city of welcome,
has given rise to ideas, institutions
and forms whose reach
goes far beyond its own territory.
text.esprit.1:
In 1929, the writer and thinker Robert de Traz
gave this singularity a name:
text.esprit.3:
A tradition of the city’s own: giving birth
locally to forms able to spill over into the world.
text.figures.4: Three figures help us grasp its logic.
text.calvin.1: Calvin, for rigour and ethical demand as the foundation of a responsible community.
text.rousseau.1: Rousseau, for openness to the world through a sensitive thinking of the universal.
text.dunant.1: Dunant, for the invention of a political compassion, turned into international law.
text.trois-manieres.1:
Three different ways of reaching
the universal from one place.
text.bien-commun.1: This dynamic has produced major forms of the common good:
text.bien-commun.2:
Multilateralism,
which gave rise to the UN
text.bien-commun.3:
The International Committee
of the Red Cross.
text.bien-commun.7:
In each case, a local initiative, able to gain
a reach far greater than itself.
text.objectif.1:
Until now, this spirit has mostly expressed itself
in the institutional field.
text.objectif-2.1:
Our aim is to activate it in the field of contemporary creation
to extend its transformative power by other means.
text.objectif-3.1:
The project proposes to make Geneva a contemporary laboratory for this transposition.
A space where a tradition historically fertile in the political field can be translated
into cultural, artistic and experimental practices that work for the common good.
text.objectif-3.2: What is at stake is testing a capacity for impact through creation.
text.reactiver.1:
Creatively reactivating the Esprit de Genève
to make creation
a tool for rethinking the common.
text.p1.1:
Seek what is right rather than what is striking.
Hold form, idea and gesture together.
text.p2.1:
Bring disciplines, cultures
and knowledge together.
Creation is built through exchange.
text.p3.1:
Design forms that do not close in on themselves.
Make creation a space
of relation, use or sharing.
text.p4.1:
Welcome divergence without trying to erase it.
Make neutrality a fertile ground
for experimentation.
text.p5.1:
Start from a precise place while aiming wider.
Produce forms able to resonate
beyond their original context.
text.p6.1:
Document, pass on, make accessible.
An idea gains strength when it can circulate.
text.agir.1:
The Esprit de Genève is not only a heritage.
It is a singular way of acting on the world,
and our ambition is to test
its full strength today through creation.
